OpportunityFully Funded PhD in AI for Engineering, Materials and Wearable Technologies at the University of Manchester
HostUniversity of Manchester
LocationManchester, United Kingdom
Study LevelPhD
FundingFully Funded, stipend provided, tuition covered
StipendGBP 21,805 per year (2026/27 UKRI rate, tax-free)
Application Deadline30 March 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

About the Position

Unlike a tightly predefined PhD topic, this studentship allows the final project to be developed jointly between the successful applicant and supervisor. The research direction can therefore be adapted to the candidate's technical background and interests.

Potential Research Topics

Possible areas include: artificial intelligence for engineering; machine learning; computer vision; computer graphics; 3D body scanning; digital human modelling; garment fit assessment; cloth simulation; digital twins; wearable sensing; smart textiles; digital fashion; and AI-based analysis of clothing and human-body data. This flexibility makes the project particularly suitable for applicants working across AI, robotics, engineering and wearable technologies.

Relevant Academic Backgrounds

Applicants may come from fields such as: artificial intelligence; computer science; machine learning; computer vision; robotics; computer graphics; textile engineering; wearable technology; fashion technology; digital fashion; human-body modelling; or related engineering disciplines.

Funding

The current advertised project provides: a 3.5-year fully funded PhD; £21,805 annual tax-free stipend at the 2026/27 UKRI rate; and tuition fees. The stipend is expected to increase in subsequent years in line with the relevant funding rate. The advertised funding is restricted to applicants eligible for UK Home fee status.

Application Process

Applicants are advised to contact the project supervisor before formally applying and provide a CV. A formal postgraduate research application must then be submitted through the University of Manchester system.

Verification Note

The specific vacancy details were found through a current external PhD listing rather than a dedicated indexed Manchester vacancy page. The University of Manchester's official Department of Materials pages do confirm that it is recruiting for 2027 postgraduate research, including doctoral programmes in areas such as Textiles and Apparel, Materials, Polymers and Composites, Nano and Functional Materials and related disciplines. Applicants should confirm that the exact project remains available with the Department or supervisor before submitting an application.

Key Details

  • Duration: 3.5 years
  • Start: January 2027
  • Deadline: 30 March 2027
  • Stipend: £21,805 per year (2026/27 UKRI rate)
  • Tuition fees: Covered
  • Funding eligibility: UK Home-fee status candidates

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.materials.manchester.ac.uk/study/postgraduate-research/

Source: materials.manchester.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 30 March 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

About University of Manchester

The University of Manchester is a public research university in Manchester, England, and a member of the Russell Group. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes across engineering, science, medicine, business and the humanities. Its research community connects academic discovery with challenges in health, sustainability, technology and society through collaboration.

Official website: https://www.manchester.ac.uk/

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 30 March 2027. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
